mappings.note: Asks the student to show the अगाध दास्य भक्ति visible in the second pad. The deliverable is the named devotional mode and its feeling, i.e. भाव-पक्ष -- LO-5 rather than LO-4's content recall.

Compares Meera with Mahadevi Verma and asks for the student's own view. It reaches outside the prescribed pads, so neither LO-4 (काव्यबोध on the set poems) nor LO-5 (their भाव/कला) fits; it is literary appreciation at competency level. Not C-H2.4 either -- no composition form is prescribed.
Which examples Meera cites when begging Krishna to remove her pain (Draupadi, Prahlad, Gajraj). A list drawn from the first pad, so LO-4 and not LO-5.
Which names Meera gives her lord in the पद (गिरधर, गोपाल, नंदलाल...). A list recalled from the text, so LO-4 -- the sibling item that asks why he is called 'गिरधर' is the LO-5 one.
Stem asks for the काव्य-सौंदर्य of the द्रोपदी/नरहरि couplet. काव्य-सौंदर्य is the कला-पक्ष by definition, so LO-5, not LO-4.
काव्य-सौंदर्य of the 'चाकर रहस्यूँ...' stanza -- diction, Rajasthani forms and lyric flow are what earn the marks. LO-5 rather than LO-4.
काव्य-सौंदर्य of the 'मोर मुकुट पीताम्बर सोहै' stanza -- the portrait's imagery and sound. कला-पक्ष, so LO-5; the plain recall of the same details is mapped LO-4 elsewhere.
What the 'कुंजर पीर' was and how it ended -- retelling the गजेंद्र मोक्ष episode the pad alludes to. Narrative content, so LO-4 and not the कला-पक्ष outcome LO-5.
Whom Meera calls 'गिरधर' and why -- construing the epithet and what it conveys of Krishna's भक्त-वत्सलता. A gloss on the poet's chosen word, hence LO-5 rather than LO-4.
Stem is 'भाव स्पष्ट करें' on the opening lines of the first pad. That is the LO-5 deliverable; LO-4 would fit only a factual question about the same allusions.
Why she wants the चाकरी and why worldly comfort is not her aim, explicitly 'मीरा के पद के आधार पर'. The answer is reasoned from the pad's stated wishes, so LO-4 rather than LO-5.
Which arguments Meera advances to press for darshan -- enumerated from the second pad. Content comprehension, so LO-4 and not LO-5.
Asks the प्रतिपाद्य of Meera's पद -- the central theme and governing emotion. That is भाव-पक्ष, so LO-5; LO-4 covers particular facts, not the poems' burden.
A note on Meera's लोक-कल्याण भावना from the first pad. Naming and discussing a भावना is LO-5, not the factual recall of LO-4.
